idea-plugin.name: Audio Explainer
idea-plugin.description:
Spoken, line-highlighted walkthroughs of your code. An AI agent reads the code and writes the walkthrough. The IDE plays it back step by step.

Ask

  • Right-click → Explain This (Audio).
  • Works on a selection, the method or class under the cursor, or a file or folder in the Solution Explorer / Project view.
  • Explain This (Audio) with… sets depth, effort and extra instructions for one run.
  • Progress shows live in the Audio Explainer tool window. The agent's run log is one click away.

Follow along

  • A tree of code tab shows only the lines that matter. The rest folds away.
  • Each callee opens under the line that calls it.
  • Highlights and notes move with the narration. Arrows link a value to the line it reaches.
  • Player: play / pause, previous / next step, 1×–2× speed, volume, voice, live transcript.
  • Outline of scenes and steps. Click a step to jump to it.
  • Save a walkthrough with the project. Replay it later with no agent call.
  • Each project window keeps its own walkthrough.

Listen

  • Four voice engines: Kokoro and Piper (neural, offline), Windows SAPI, espeak-ng.
  • About 50 languages for the explanation and the voice. The menu label follows the language.
  • Speech is synthesized on your machine. Exception: Windows online voices use Microsoft's service.
  • No voices installed? The walkthrough still plays as highlights and text.

Pick your model

  • Agents: Claude Code CLI, or an ACP agent: opencode, Qwen Code or a custom one.
  • Point Claude Code at another provider: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen (DashScope), local Ollama or a custom endpoint.
  • Browse OpenRouter's tool-capable models with their prices.
  • API keys stay in the IDE password safe.

Requires

  • An agent: the Claude Code CLI on PATH, or an ACP agent.
  • For narration: Python 3.10+. Tools → Audio Explainer → Audio engines… installs the voices.

Your code goes only to the agent or provider you choose. Third-party agents and providers are not supported by Anthropic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — first release.
  • Explain This (Audio) on a selection, the symbol under the cursor, or a file or folder; a tree of code that follows the narration.
  • Agents: the Claude Code CLI, or any ACP agent (opencode, Qwen Code, a custom one).
  • Narration in ~50 languages across Kokoro, Piper, Windows SAPI and espeak-ng.
  • Note: Explain This passes --effort medium to Claude by default, overriding an effortLevel in ~/.claude/settings.json. Choose Default — inherit in Settings to keep yours.
